name: @prc/spoken-article
description: Audio player block for AI-generated spoken article narration

scripts.build: npm run build:blocks && npm run build:sidebar
scripts.build:blocks: wp-scripts build --source-path=./src/player-block --output-path=./build/player-block --webpack-copy-php --experimental-modules; wp-scripts build --source-path=./src/player-trigger-block --output-path=./build/player-trigger-block --webpack-copy-php --experimental-modules; wp-scripts build --source-path=./src/player-add-to-queue-block --output-path=./build/player-add-to-queue-block --webpack-copy-php --experimental-modules
